Historical reader and controller fixtures from v0.3.12, commit `3fb1c2a3a4e25fccee6a2454f02f0675579a11dc`.

The three complete modules are exact source bytes. `finish_previews.py.txt` and `runtime_state.py.txt` are the exact `_finish_previews` and `_load` methods, with class indentation removed. Tests use these files without Git history or network access. Do not update them when current code changes.
